limitations: Other control-field consumers may still use defaults for explicitly invalid values; only load now rejects these before its action RPC/signing.
blocks accepts positive strings up to platform MaxInt at runtime; Web numeric inputs stay in JSON safe range. Its string schema requires positivity but runtime enforces the platform maximum.
